mapper.select: select delivery_id from wave_list as pw left join wave_list_detail as pwd on pw.id = pwd.main_id and pwd.is_deleted = false where pw.status = #{status} and pw.is_deleted = false

SELECT pwd.main_id, pwd.basket_no, pwd.delivery_id, pd.id as pickDetailId, pd.sku_id, pd.sku_no, pd.picked_qty, pd.allocated_qty FROM wave_list_detail AS pwd LEFT JOIN so_b2c_delivery_detail AS sbdd ON sbdd.is_deleted = FALSE AND sbdd.main_id = pwd.delivery_id LEFT JOIN picking_detail AS pd ON pd.is_deleted = FALSE AND pd.source_detail_id = sbdd.ID

select count(pwd.delivery_id) FROM wave_list as pw LEFT JOIN wave_list_detail as pwd on pwd.main_id = pw.id and pwd.is_deleted = false WHERE pw.is_deleted = false and pw.status = 'await_pick'
